project.title: Harptos Calendar Tracker
project.summary: A Dungeon Master’s tracker for Harptos campaign time, local light, and hourly weather across Faerûn, with other setting calendars planned later.

items.title: Run tests and production build on every pull request
items.notes: Add CI that runs npm ci, npm test, and npm run build on pull requests and main. The domain suite already covers calendar and weather regressions; nothing currently blocks a merge or deploy when those checks fail.

items.title: Keep in-tab campaign edits after a failed browser save
items.notes: updateSavedCampaign currently bases the next snapshot on localStorage before applying the change. After a failed setItem, React can hold a newer clock while storage stays old; the next successful edit reloads storage and can discard the in-tab time, location, or seed. Prefer the in-memory campaign as the write base from the UI. Revisit multi-tab sync with storage events only if DMs need it.

items.title: Cover share preview and adopt flows with automated UI tests
items.notes: Domain modules are well tested; share URL preview, adopt, back to saved campaign, invalid share notice, and clipboard fallback are manual-only. Add a small Playwright or Testing Library set for those paths so UI regressions fail CI.

items.title: Show a visible Harptos calendar on the tracker
items.notes: The screen shows the current date as text and advances by controls; DMs cannot see the surrounding month, festivals, or tenday layout at a glance. Add a calendar view of the current Harptos month (including festival days and Shieldmeet) that highlights the campaign day and stays in sync when the clock advances or is set.

items.title: Split CampaignLedger into focused UI sections
items.notes: App.tsx CampaignLedger owns clock display, advances, editor wiring, notices, summary copy, share UI, preview adoption, and location selection. Extract share preview, summary/copy, and location fieldset when the next UI feature lands; keep derived daylight and weather in the parent.

items.title: Stop keying translations by English display copy
items.notes: localization.ts maps Simplified Chinese by English source strings, so copy edits silently fall back to English. Move to stable message IDs, or add a test that every user-visible string used under zh-Hans has a map entry.

items.title: Add lint and format checks to local scripts and CI
items.notes: There is no ESLint, Prettier, or Biome today. Add a formatter and linter, wire npm scripts, and run them in CI beside test and build.

items.title: Remove or wire unused tenday and Halruaa helpers
items.notes: getTenday is exported and tested but unused in the UI. daylight.ts special-cases a halruaa location outside campaignLocations. Either surface tenday in the ledger and catalog Halruaa, or delete the dead paths.

items.title: Support calendars for non-Faerûn campaign locations
items.notes: Add calendar rules for Galifar, Sigil, Radiant Citadel, Exandria, Krynn, and Greyhawk. Reveal those catalog locations in the selector once each calendar can drive the clock.
